description: Source code implementing wrapper functions for RWByteAddressBuffer Load/Store operations in HLSL, including functions for load, store, length, and atomic operations, with support for scalar, vector, and matrix types.

classes.name: ShaderStorageBlockFunctionHLSL
classes.description: Namespace containing static functions for generating HLSL code for shader storage buffer operations.

methods.name: OutputSSBOLoadFunctionBody
methods.description: Generates HLSL code for loading data from a buffer based on the type and layout.

methods.name: OutputSSBOStoreFunctionBody
methods.description: Generates HLSL code for storing data into a buffer based on the type and layout.

methods.name: OutputSSBOLengthFunctionBody
methods.description: Generates HLSL code for calculating the length of an unsized buffer.

methods.name: OutputSSBOAtomicMemoryFunctionBody
methods.description: Generates HLSL code for atomic memory operations on buffers.

methods.name: registerShaderStorageBlockFunction
methods.description: Registers a shader storage block function with specific parameters and generates a function name.

methods.name: shaderStorageBlockFunctionHeader
methods.description: Outputs the header and body of all registered shader storage block functions in HLSL.
